page: Amazon Web Services m8id.12xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance provides 48 vCPUs across 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system features 192 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, translating to 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It includes 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 22 Gbps. The underlying virtualization is managed by the AWS Nitro hypervisor.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates strong performance characteristics, particularly in memory-bound and text-processing workloads. Geekbench single-core, image processing, and text processing scores place the instance in the top 10% tier. Memory bandwidth tests show strong read-only performance, reaching 3830.37 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 195.99 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. The CPU features Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512), which support efficient local LLM inference. For example, text generation using a small 135M model achieves a top-tier speed of 356.29 tokens per second, while prompt processing for a medium 7B model reaches 251.06 tokens per second.

The inclusion of 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD storage offers high-speed, low-latency data access directly on the host, which is highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring high resource density without the overhead of network-attached storage. However, because this is ephemeral instance storage, data persistence must be managed externally. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance well-suited for general-purpose applications, database operations, static web serving, software compilation, and medium-scale machine learning inference tasks that do not require dedicated GPU acceleration.
description: Amazon Web Services m8id.12xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 48 vCPUs, 24 physical Intel Xeon 6975P-C cores, and 192 GB of 7 GHz DDR5 memory. Operating on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, it integrates 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage and a 22 Gbps baseline network interface. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel AMX, contributing to top-tier performance in single-core execution, image processing, and text processing benchmarks. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with cached read speeds reaching 3830.37 GB/sec. This hardware profile delivers qualitative cost efficiency for resource-dense workloads by bundling high-capacity local storage with balanced compute and memory. The instance is optimized for database operations, static web serving, software compilation, and CPU-based LLM inference.
